usedFor: Shopify holds customers, and Sukam Apps CRM holds leads, so “Customer Updated” can add one with “Create a Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Customer Updated” in Shopify, then “Create a Lead” in Sukam Apps CRM
bestTemplate.why: Customer changes reach the CRM as a new lead, so sales sees them.

watchOut: “Customer Updated” runs on every update, so the same customer can run “Create a Lead” more than once.
